title: Tressfecta wants to make hair braiding a less arduous task for hairstylists | TechCrunch
summary: Aisata Diallo, 24, calls herself a lifelong braider. “I’ve always braided my hair growing up and, at some point in my college career, started braiding other people’s hair,” she said.
